```{r setup}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(ggnewscale)

project_dir <- normalizePath("/home/xuyanbo/project/MOF_TAPS", mustWork = TRUE)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 3, dev = "cairo_pdf", dev.args = list(family = "Arial"))

font_family <- "Arial"
out_fig_dir <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  "analysis", "fig_factory", "fig", "Fig6"
)
dir.create(out_fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

corr_bin_size <- 10000L
min_corr_bin_total_N <- 10L
min_corr_bin_cpgs <- 1L
corr_density_bins <- 50L

method_order <- c("TAPS+", "MOF-TAPS")
clinical_status_order <- c("AML", "Healthy")
sample_index_order <- as.character(1:3)

clinical_fill <- c(
  "AML"     = "#957FBB",
  "Healthy" = "#78B4BC"
)

set.seed(1)
```

```{r sample-meta}
filtered_bedgraph_dir <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  "analysis", "cfDNA", "result", "05methy_call", "filter_taps_bedGraph"
)

meta <- tibble::tibble(
  sample = c(
    "FYM_260410_S01", "FYM_260410_S02", "FYM_260410_S03",
    "FYM_260410_S04", "FYM_260410_S05", "FYM_260410_S06",
    "FYM_260410_S07", "FYM_260410_S08", "FYM_260410_S09",
    "FYM_260410_S10", "FYM_260410_S11", "FYM_260410_S12"
  ),
  method = c(
    rep("TAPS+", 6),
    rep("MOF-TAPS", 6)
  ),
  clinical_status = c(
    rep("Healthy", 3), rep("AML", 3),
    rep("Healthy", 3), rep("AML", 3)
  ),
  sample_id = c(
    "H1", "H2", "H3", "A1", "A2", "A3",
    "H1", "H2", "H3", "A1", "A2", "A3"
  ),
  sample_index = c(
    1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3,
    1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = method_order),
    clinical_status = factor(clinical_status, levels = clinical_status_order),
    sample_index = factor(sample_index, levels = sample_index_order),
    file = file.path(filtered_bedgraph_dir, paste0(sample, ".minTotal3.filter_taps.bedGraph"))
  )

pair_info <- meta %>%
  select(sample, method, clinical_status, sample_id, sample_index, file) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = method,
    values_from = c(sample, file),
    names_sep = "__"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    taps_sample = `sample__TAPS+`,
    mof_sample = `sample__MOF-TAPS`,
    taps_file = `file__TAPS+`,
    mof_file = `file__MOF-TAPS`
  ) %>%
  arrange(clinical_status, sample_index)

pair_info
```

# Paired cfDNA filtered TAPS readout correlation

```{r helper-summarize-filtered-taps-bins}
summarize_filtered_taps_bins <- function(file, bin_size) {
  cmd <- sprintf(
    paste0(
      "zcat -f %s | awk -v BS=%d '",
      "BEGIN{OFS=\"\t\"} ",
      "$0 !~ /^(track|browser|#)/ { ",
      "  cov = $6; ",
      "  bin = int($2 / BS) * BS; ",
      "  key = $1 SUBSEP bin; ",
      "  positive[key] += $5; total[key] += cov; cpg[key] += 1; ",
      "} ",
      "END{ ",
      "  for (key in total) { ",
      "    split(key, a, SUBSEP); ",
      "    print a[1], a[2], a[2] + BS, a[2] + BS / 2, positive[key], total[key], cpg[key]; ",
      "  } ",
      "}'"
    ),
    shQuote(file), bin_size
  )

  x <- data.table::fread(
    cmd = cmd,
    header = FALSE,
    col.names = c("chr", "bin_start", "bin_end", "bin_mid", "positive", "N", "covered_CpGs"),
    showProgress = FALSE
  )

  x[, `:=`(
    bin_start = as.integer(bin_start),
    bin_end = as.integer(bin_end),
    bin_mid = as.numeric(bin_mid),
    positive = as.numeric(positive),
    N = as.numeric(N),
    covered_CpGs = as.integer(covered_CpGs)
  )]

  x <- x[N > 0]
  x[, taps_readout_rate := 100 * positive / N]
  x[N >= min_corr_bin_total_N & covered_CpGs >= min_corr_bin_cpgs]
}
```


```{r summarize-all-samples-correlation-bins}
corr_sample_bin_list <- vector("list", nrow(meta))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(meta))) {
  message("Summarizing filtered TAPS readout ", corr_bin_size, " bp bins for ", meta$sample[i])

  x <- summarize_filtered_taps_bins(
    file = meta$file[i],
    bin_size = corr_bin_size
  )

  x[, sample := meta$sample[i]]
  x[, method := as.character(meta$method[i])]
  x[, clinical_status := as.character(meta$clinical_status[i])]
  x[, sample_id := meta$sample_id[i]]
  x[, sample_index := as.character(meta$sample_index[i])]

  corr_sample_bin_list[[i]] <- x
}

corr_sample_bin_df <- data.table::rbindlist(corr_sample_bin_list, use.names = TRUE)
corr_sample_bin_df[, method := factor(method, levels = method_order)]
corr_sample_bin_df[, clinical_status := factor(clinical_status, levels = clinical_status_order)]
corr_sample_bin_df[, sample_index := factor(sample_index, levels = sample_index_order)]

corr_sample_bin_df[1:10]
```

```{r summarize-paired-correlation-bins}
pair_plot_list <- vector("list", nrow(pair_info))
pair_label_list <- vector("list", nrow(pair_info))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(pair_info))) {
  p <- pair_info[i, ]

  taps_dt <- corr_sample_bin_df[
    sample == p$taps_sample,
    .(chr, bin_start, bin_end, bin_mid, taps_rate = taps_readout_rate)
  ]

  mof_dt <- corr_sample_bin_df[
    sample == p$mof_sample,
    .(chr, bin_start, bin_end, bin_mid, mof_rate = taps_readout_rate)
  ]

  shared_dt <- merge(
    taps_dt,
    mof_dt,
    by = c("chr", "bin_start", "bin_end", "bin_mid"),
    all = FALSE
  )

  pair_plot_list[[i]] <- shared_dt[
    ,
    `:=`(
      clinical_status = as.character(p$clinical_status),
      sample_id = as.character(p$sample_id),
      sample_index = as.character(p$sample_index)
    )
  ]

  pair_label_list[[i]] <- data.table::data.table(
    clinical_status = as.character(p$clinical_status),
    sample_id = as.character(p$sample_id),
    sample_index = as.character(p$sample_index),
    n_bins = nrow(shared_dt),
    pearson_r = if (nrow(shared_dt) >= 3) cor(shared_dt$taps_rate, shared_dt$mof_rate, method = "pearson") else NA_real_
  )
}

pair_corr_plot_df <- data.table::rbindlist(pair_plot_list, use.names = TRUE)
pair_corr_label <- data.table::rbindlist(pair_label_list, use.names = TRUE)

pair_corr_plot_df[, clinical_status := factor(clinical_status, levels = clinical_status_order)]
pair_corr_plot_df[, sample_index := factor(sample_index, levels = sample_index_order)]
pair_corr_label[, clinical_status := factor(clinical_status, levels = clinical_status_order)]
pair_corr_label[, sample_index := factor(sample_index, levels = sample_index_order)]
pair_corr_label[, label := paste0(sample_id, "\nr = ", sprintf("%.2f", pearson_r))]
pair_corr_label[, `:=`(x = 5, y = 96)]

pair_corr_label
```

```{r}
write.csv(

write.csv(
```

```{r estimate-bin-count-scale}
tmp_bin_plot <- ggplot(
  pair_corr_plot_df,
  aes(x = taps_rate, y = mof_rate)
) +
  geom_bin_2d(bins = corr_density_bins) +
  facet_grid(sample_index ~ clinical_status, drop = FALSE)

tmp_bin_data_all <- ggplot_build(tmp_bin_plot)$data[[1]]

bin_count_min <- 1L
bin_count_max_display <- ceiling(
  as.numeric(quantile(tmp_bin_data_all$count, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)) / 1000
) * 1000

bin_count_breaks <- c(bin_count_min, bin_count_max_display)
bin_count_labels <- c("1", scales::comma(bin_count_max_display))

bin_count_max_display
```

```{r plot-paired-bin-correlation}
p_paired_bin_correlation <- ggplot() +
  geom_bin_2d(
    data = pair_corr_plot_df %>% filter(clinical_status == "AML"),
    aes(x = taps_rate, y = mof_rate, fill = after_stat(count)),
    bins = corr_density_bins,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#FFF7F7",
    high = clinical_fill["AML"],
    limits = c(bin_count_min, bin_count_max_display),
    oob = scales::squish,
    breaks = bin_count_breaks,
    labels = bin_count_labels,
    name = "AML\nbin count",
    guide = guide_colourbar(
      order = 1,
      barheight = unit(2.0, "cm"),
      barwidth = unit(0.35, "cm"),
      ticks = TRUE,
      frame.colour = "black",
      label.position = "right",
      label.hjust = 0,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0,
      label.theme = element_text(
        margin = margin(l = 1, r = 0)
      ),
      title.theme = element_text(
        lineheight = 0.75, margin = margin(b = 8, r = 0)
      )
    )
  ) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_bin_2d(
    data = pair_corr_plot_df %>% filter(clinical_status == "Healthy"),
    aes(x = taps_rate, y = mof_rate, fill = after_stat(count)),
    bins = corr_density_bins,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#F7FBFF",
    high = clinical_fill["Healthy"],
    limits = c(bin_count_min, bin_count_max_display),
    oob = scales::squish,
    breaks = bin_count_breaks,
    labels = bin_count_labels,
    name = "Healthy\nbin count",
    guide = guide_colourbar(
      order = 2,
      barheight = unit(2.0, "cm"),
      barwidth = unit(0.35, "cm"),
      ticks = TRUE,
      frame.colour = "black",
      label.position = "right",
      label.hjust = 0,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0,
      label.theme = element_text(
        margin = margin(l = 1, r = 0)
      ),
      title.theme = element_text(
        lineheight = 0.75, margin = margin(b = 8, r = 0)
      )
    )
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.42,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = pair_corr_label,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 4.8,
    family = font_family,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_grid(clinical_status ~ sample_index, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  coord_fixed(
    xlim = c(0, 100),
    ylim = c(0, 100),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "TAPS+ methylation level (%)",
    y = "MOF-TAPS methylation level (%)"
  ) +
  theme_fig6 +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.32, linetype = "dashed"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8))
  )
```
